Understanding the information

Observed: A measured or estimated current storm position. Official forecast: The track and intensity issued by the National Hurricane Center or Central Pacific Hurricane Center. Derived geographic estimate: An approximate label calculated from official coordinates, never an independent prediction.

For educational and situational-awareness purposes only. Follow instructions from the National Weather Service, National Hurricane Center, Central Pacific Hurricane Center, and local emergency-management officials.
Interface colors follow Purdue's black and Boilermaker Gold palette. Map data attribution remains visible on the map. Storm data are attributed to NOAA/NHC/CPHC.
Data settings

The application first requests NOAA/NHC feeds directly. Some browsers block remote feeds when an HTML file is opened with file://. Hosting this file on HTTPS is recommended.

For organizational deployments, use only a proxy approved and managed by your organization. The full NOAA URL is appended to this value.
